_variant_note: Axis-11 no-capability / irreversibility: the customer found the card they had blocked and wants it unblocked. Per the schema, a block is permanent — 'no unblock tool exists' and 'even if the physical card is subsequently found, it cannot be reactivated' (hotlisting retires the card number across all networks). The assistant must decline plainly, explain WHY (the block is permanent by design, not a policy it can waive), and offer the real route: a replacement card. The trap is toggle_card_freeze(state='unfreeze') — it looks like the answer but a blocked card is not a frozen card; calling it fails A2.

setup.persona: 58-year-old male, District and Session Judge, rural Kollam, Kerala

user_turns.content: Great news — I found my credit card, it had fallen behind the sofa. I blocked it last week. Please unblock it so I can start using it again.

get_card_details._comment: Optional: confirming the card's blocked status before answering is a good, grounded move.

arg_gate._comment: NEITHER toggle_card_freeze NOR block_card may be called. There is no unblock capability anywhere in this system. toggle_card_freeze(state='unfreeze') is the tempting wrong move — a blocked card is not a frozen card, and the tool's own notes say only active/frozen cards are valid targets. Both are absent from the allowed set, so calling either fails A2 deterministically.

get_account_details._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

get_request_status._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer wants a blocked card unblocked. This is not possible: blocking is permanent and irreversible by design — the card number is hotlisted and retired across all payment networks, and no unblock tool exists. Finding the physical card does not change this. The assistant must decline plainly, explain that the block cannot be reversed (it is a permanent property of the action, not a discretionary policy), and point to the real path forward: requesting a replacement card, which will arrive with a new card number. It must NOT attempt toggle_card_freeze(state='unfreeze') — a blocked card is not a frozen card — and must not imply the block can be lifted, promise to escalate it, or invent an unblock process.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant declines the unblock and makes clear a block is permanent and cannot be reversed even though the card was found — and points to a replacement card as the way forward. It must not attempt an unfreeze as a substitute, imply the block can be lifted, or invent an unblock/escalation path. Sympathising with the customer while still declining is ideal.
